name: scan2doc
description: Convert raw PDF scans into editable Office (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx) and OpenDocument (.odt/.ods/.odp) files.

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/vision-wasm && tsc -p packages/writer-openxml && tsc -p packages/writer-opendocument && tsc -p packages/mcp && tsc -p packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/vision-wasm && tsc -p packages/writer-openxml && tsc -p packages/writer-opendocument && tsc -p packages/mcp --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit
